name: Best Video Games of All Time - Metacritic
description: Dataset derived from the Kaggle dataset 'Best Video Games of All Time - Metacritic'. It contains around 20,500 videogames with information about their release date, developer, platform, genres, number of players, ESRB rating, metascore, user score.

variableMeasured.name: mc_id
variableMeasured.description: Metacritic-derived record identifier for the videogame

variableMeasured.name: game_title
variableMeasured.description: Videogame title as listed by Metacritic

variableMeasured.name: year_published
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: made_by
variableMeasured.description: Developer or studio listed by Metacritic

variableMeasured.name: console
variableMeasured.description: Platform or console listed by Metacritic
